trust_decision.summary: Whether a partial-pipeline token supplied in the request (or as an explicit argument) may resume a stored partial pipeline in this session; at the pinned commit any request token is trusted over the session's own token and only backend name / uid are compared, so a token from another session resumes that session's pipeline (login CSRF / session fixation).

landing_point.why: partial_pipeline_data is where the partial token is chosen (request param first, session last) and loaded; anyone searching for 'partial token' / session fixation lands here.
